title: Decay operability at the matrix horizon: a reported result, not a judged one

provenance.run_by: the owner, on their local machine
provenance.artifact_here: absent from this worktree, so no figures were recomputed from a series
provenance.authority: the artifact once committed; this record is re-checked against it then
provenance.why_it_matters: a transcribed table is a new claim; the check must be mechanical, not careful reading

run.settings: the matrix's own world, cadence and hash seed, both arms in one process

liveness_gate: at least one theory in every cycle of the last tenth, and a mean of at least two beliefs across it

decay_on.status: dies earlier; the matrix arm on the same build loses theories by cycle 37 and beliefs by cycle 112 (docs/RERUN-0.12.0.md)

edge_mass.quantity: SUM(precedes.count) over the precedes table: accumulated transition weight
edge_mass.not: not a row count: edges are COUNT(*) and the artifact carries them separately
edge_mass.row_count_source: owner-reported; the 80-cycle row count was not reported, so 'unchanged' is the owner's reading, not something this record checked

derived.note: arithmetic on the two reported masses; a mean rate is not a trajectory

growth_criterion: unset: no bound was pre-committed, so growth is reported and not judged
caveats: no bar existed before the run, and a bar read off this curve is taken from the run it judges
a mean per-cycle rate is not a trajectory; the shape lives in the artifact's decile snapshots
one seed, one stimulus, one horizon
certifies: liveness at 3,000 cycles for the decay-off arm
does_not_certify: resource soundness: growth is monotone across the measured horizon and no deceleration was measured
a decay verdict: the matched decay-on/off comparison has not run
the longitudinal study's horizon, which is longer than this check
a latency or CPU cost estimate: wall-clock for the run was not part of what was reported

db.reading: storage did not track mass: a 1.55x database against a 108.715x mass

reading: weight accumulation on a fixed relation set: the mass grew because stored pairs were reinforced, not because more pairs were stored; 197,753 is not a row count and the growth is not a storage multiplier

necessity.established: this decay factor is incompatible with liveness on this stream and horizon, while the counterfactual factor is live there
necessity.why: one factor at one horizon is not a necessity claim: the matched decay-on/off comparison that would estimate the parameter's causal effect has not run
necessity.not: not refuted and not supported; two points of the parameter range were observed
